'''''Blackjack''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]]. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was on its way to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Sunaj IV)|''Relentless'']] carrying a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] when it was shot down by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] in a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]].

{{Ship-stub}}

The ship appears 20 minutes from start of mission 17b.
